parts.name: Fan
parts.Basic_description: This is the rotating fan blade assembly made of plastic, typically lightweight and durable.
parts.Functional_description: The fan blades rotate to generate airflow, moving air through the frame for cooling or ventilation purposes.
parts.Movement_description: This part rotates around its central axis when powered by a motor.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or frame of the fan, made of aluminum for structural support and heat dissipation.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the fan blades and motor in place, providing stability and mounting points for installation.
parts.Movement_description: This part remains stationary and does not move during operation.
